title: Vaccine-Type HPV Prevalence in Teen Girls

source.name: Genital HPV Infection — Statistics (NHANES surveillance)
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: CDC/NHANES surveillance found vaccine-type HPV prevalence among females aged 14-19 fell from about 11.5% (2003-2006, pre-vaccine) to about 1.8% (2015-2018) — roughly an 88% relative decline. Recalled from published CDC surveillance figures; not live-refreshed this run because outbound network access was unavailable in this session.
